record.title: Evaluate loader controls and freeze or reject a stock observation
record.intent: Require evidence-backed instrumentation before the full stock loader-region experiment.
requirements: Independently review complete private results source and verifier coverage; resolve capture thread or stop failures as their own finding rather than adapting a stock experiment in place.
Freeze exact binary source fixture checkpoint sequence deadline thread coverage expected statuses and destination comparison rules only when controls support them.

Either admit a bounded stock-loader experiment and evaluation with taskctl plan inspection or close with a specific instrumentation successor; commit and push the decision and tasking before execution.
acceptance: Commit and push an explicit go or no-go decision and bounded successor tasking.
